types.name: transfer.v1.BatchCreateInternalTransfersRequest
types.doc:
BatchCreateInternalTransfersRequest submits up to 10 independent Trading to
 Trading transfers under one idempotency key and one MFA check.

fields.name: legs
fields.doc:
Transfers to run, in order. At most 10 legs; each leg counts as one
 internal transfer against the caller's rate limit. Legs may repeat an asset,
 a source or a destination.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc:
Stable client-supplied idempotency key used to collapse safe retries of
 the whole batch. It is scoped to the authenticated caller: the session's
 account, or the API key. A retry must send the same legs in the same
 order; different legs under the same key are refused.

types.name: transfer.v1.BatchCreateInternalTransfersResponse
types.doc: BatchCreateInternalTransfersResponse returns the outcome of every leg.

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc:
Stable server-owned identifier of the batch request. Empty when the batch
 was refused.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Outcome of the batch as a whole.

fields.name: legs
fields.doc: One result per requested leg, in request order.

types.name: transfer.v1.CreateDustConversionRequest
types.doc: CreateDustConversionRequest converts one quote.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional public subaccount ID; it must select the quote's account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc: Stable client-supplied key collapsing retries for the account.

fields.name: quote_id
fields.doc:
Quote from QuoteDustConversion, at most 30 seconds old. A quote converts
 once.

types.name: transfer.v1.CreateDustConversionResponse
types.doc: CreateDustConversionResponse returns the conversion.

fields.name: conversion
fields.doc:
The conversion: completed, or still processing when its outcome is not
 known yet.

types.name: transfer.v1.CreateInternalTransferRequest
types.doc:
CreateInternalTransferRequest creates or returns one accepted Trading
 to Trading internal transfer for the authenticated source account.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional source public subaccount ID. When omitted, subaccount-scoped API
 keys use their bound subaccount; other callers use their authenticated
 root account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: destination_account_id
fields.doc: Destination root account public id.

fields.name: destination_subaccount_id
fields.doc: Destination subaccount public id.

fields.name: destination_smart_account_address
fields.doc: Destination smart-account address.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: Canonical public unified asset id for the asset being transferred.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc:
Transfer amount in canonical 18-decimal unified asset units.
 For example, 0.5 is encoded as 500000000000000000.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc: Stable client-supplied idempotency key used to collapse safe retries.

types.name: transfer.v1.CreateInternalTransferResponse
types.doc:
CreateInternalTransferResponse returns the accepted request and transfer
 identifiers for later correlation.

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc: Stable server-owned request identifier for this intake.

fields.name: transfer_id
fields.doc: Stable transfer identifier for the settled internal transfer.

fields.name: accepted_at_ts_ns
fields.doc: Acceptance timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch (server time).

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: Echoed canonical public unified asset id.

fields.name: asset_code
fields.doc: Resolved asset code for convenience.

fields.name: u_asset_id
fields.doc: Resolved unified asset id used by downstream settlement.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc: Echoed transfer amount in canonical 18-decimal unified asset units.

fields.name: destination
fields.doc: Server-resolved destination summary.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Public status for the transfer request.

fields.name: flow_id
fields.doc:
Authoritative lifecycle flow identifier. Use GetFlowById to read the flow;
 its ledger settlement step links back through milestone_tx_ref.

types.name: transfer.v1.DustAssetEligibility
types.doc:
DustAssetEligibility says whether one Trading balance converts as dust, or
 why not.

values.name: DUST_ASSET_ELIGIBILITY_ELIGIBLE
values.doc: The whole available balance is dust and converts.

values.name: DUST_ASSET_ELIGIBILITY_TARGET_ASSET
values.doc: The asset is the conversion's target; it is never a source.

values.name: DUST_ASSET_ELIGIBILITY_TRADABLE
values.doc:
An open market accepts an order for the balance at the current index price:
 sell it, or for an asset only quoted, spend it, instead.

values.name: DUST_ASSET_ELIGIBILITY_ABOVE_VALUE_LIMIT
values.doc: The balance is worth more than 10 USD.

values.name: DUST_ASSET_ELIGIBILITY_NO_PRICE
values.doc:
The asset, or the quote asset of a market it trades on, has no current
 index price. A balance without a price is never valued at zero.

values.name: DUST_ASSET_ELIGIBILITY_UNSUPPORTED_ASSET
values.doc: The asset is not convertible.

values.name: DUST_ASSET_ELIGIBILITY_SOURCE_LIMIT
values.doc:
One conversion takes at most 20 balances, the highest-valued first; this
 one waits for the next conversion.

types.name: transfer.v1.DustAssetPrice
types.doc:
DustAssetPrice is the USD index price a quote or conversion used for one
 asset.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: Canonical public unified asset id.

fields.name: price_ticks
fields.doc: USD per whole asset unit: price_ticks / 10^price_scale.

fields.name: price_scale
fields.doc: Decimal scale of price_ticks.

fields.name: as_of
fields.doc: Time of the oldest index observation the price used.

types.name: transfer.v1.DustBalance
types.doc: DustBalance is one Trading balance judged for dust conversion.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: Canonical public unified asset id.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc:
The whole available Trading balance, in canonical 18-decimal units: what no
 open order or other reservation holds.

fields.name: eligibility
fields.doc: Whether the balance converts, and why not otherwise.

fields.name: usd_value_e18
fields.doc:
The balance's USD value in 18-decimal fixed point, rounded down. Unset when
 the asset has no current price.

types.name: transfer.v1.DustConversion
types.doc: DustConversion is one conversion of an account's dust into a target asset.

fields.name: conversion_id
fields.doc: Stable conversion identifier.

fields.name: quote_id
fields.doc: The quote the conversion converted.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Current state.

fields.name: refusal_code
fields.doc:
Why the conversion was refused; unspecified unless state is
 DUST_CONVERSION_STATE_REFUSED.

fields.name: target_asset_id
fields.doc: Target asset id.

fields.name: sources
fields.doc: Sources, in asset id order.

fields.name: payout_e18
fields.doc:
Payout in canonical 18-decimal target units, after the fee: the sources'
 value at the index prices current when the conversion was created.

fields.name: quoted_payout_e18
fields.doc: The payout the quote showed, in canonical 18-decimal target units.

fields.name: fee_e18
fields.doc: The fee taken from the payout, in canonical 18-decimal target units.

fields.name: fee_bps
fields.doc: The fee in basis points.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the conversion was created.

fields.name: completed_at
fields.doc:
When the conversion completed; unset until state is
 DUST_CONVERSION_STATE_COMPLETED.

types.name: transfer.v1.DustConversionState
types.doc: DustConversionState is a conversion's public state.

values.name: DUST_CONVERSION_STATE_PROCESSING
values.doc:
The conversion is accepted and being completed. It completes or is refused
 without any further request; read it again with GetDustConversion.

values.name: DUST_CONVERSION_STATE_COMPLETED
values.doc: Every source moved and the payout was credited, atomically.

values.name: DUST_CONVERSION_STATE_REFUSED
values.doc:
The conversion was refused: nothing moved. refusal_code says why. A refused
 conversion does not count toward the 6 hour conversion window.

types.name: transfer.v1.DustSource
types.doc: DustSource is one balance a conversion moves.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: Canonical public unified asset id.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc: The whole quoted balance, in canonical 18-decimal units.

types.name: transfer.v1.ErrorCode
types.doc:
ErrorCode identifies stable, machine-readable Internal Transfer API errors.
 Values mirror the REST problem+json code field.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS
values.doc: The source account does not have enough available Trading balance.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INVALID_REQUEST
values.doc: Request payload or one of its fields is invalid.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_UNAUTHENTICATED
values.doc: Caller is not authenticated.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_PERMISSION_DENIED
values.doc: Caller is not permitted to create the transfer.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
values.doc: Request exceeded the applicable admission rate limit.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: A required dependency is temporarily unavailable.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INTERNAL_ERROR
values.doc: The request failed because of an unexpected server error.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INVALID_SUBACCOUNT_ID
values.doc: The selected subaccount identifier is invalid.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SUBACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: The selected subaccount does not exist.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SOURCE_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE
values.doc: The source subaccount is not active.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_UNSUPPORTED_ASSET
values.doc: The requested asset is not supported for internal transfers.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INVALID_AMOUNT
values.doc: The transfer amount is invalid.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INVALID_DESTINATION
values.doc: The destination identifier is invalid.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_DESTINATION_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: The destination account or smart account could not be found.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_DESTINATION_INACTIVE
values.doc: The destination subaccount is not active.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SAME_SOURCE_DESTINATION
values.doc: Source and destination resolve to the same account.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_DESTINATION_NOT_WHITELISTED
values.doc: The destination is not present on the caller's internal whitelist.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SMART_ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: A required source or destination smart-account address is unavailable.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_STEP_UP_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: Fresh step-up verification is temporarily unavailable.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
values.doc: The idempotency key was reused with different request data.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_FUNDS_LOCK_CONFLICT
values.doc: The funds lock conflicts with an existing or finalized reservation.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_CAPITAL_VIEW_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc:
The account's available balance cannot be confirmed right now. Retry
 later.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_ACCOUNT_SHARD_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: Funds movement for this account is temporarily unavailable. Retry later.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_POLICY_DENIED
values.doc: A required account or API-key policy rejected the transfer.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_FAILED_PRECONDITION
values.doc: A required precondition was not satisfied.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: The requested resource was not found.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_CONFLICT
values.doc: The request conflicts with existing state.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_DUST_QUOTE_EXPIRED
values.doc: The dust quote is older than 30 seconds, unknown, or another account's.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_DUST_PRICE_MOVED
values.doc: The dust conversion's payout fell more than 1% below its quote.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_DUST_NOT_ELIGIBLE
values.doc: A quoted balance no longer converts as dust, or the payout rounds to zero.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_DUST_WINDOW_ACTIVE
values.doc:
The account converted dust within the last 6 hours, or a conversion is
 still processing.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_DUST_DAILY_LIMIT
values.doc: The target asset's daily dust conversion limit is reached.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_DUST_BUSY
values.doc: Too many dust conversions are in progress. Retry shortly.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_DUST_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: The target asset cannot be paid now, or has no current price.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_DUST_BALANCE_CHANGED
values.doc: A source balance moved since the quote: quote again.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_DUST_CONVERSION_FAILED
values.doc: The dust conversion could not complete. Nothing moved; quote again.

types.name: transfer.v1.ErrorDetail
types.doc: ErrorDetail is attached to ConnectRPC errors for structured error handling.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable error code matching the REST problem+json code field.

types.name: transfer.v1.GetDustConversionRequest
types.doc: GetDustConversionRequest reads one of the account's conversions.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional public subaccount ID. When omitted, subaccount-scoped API keys use
 their bound subaccount; other callers use their authenticated root account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: conversion_id
fields.doc: Conversion identifier.

types.name: transfer.v1.GetDustConversionResponse
types.doc: GetDustConversionResponse returns one conversion.

fields.name: conversion
fields.doc: The conversion.

types.name: transfer.v1.GetInternalTransferRequest
types.doc: GetInternalTransferRequest selects an accepted transfer from the source account.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional source public subaccount ID. Omitted means the authenticated root
 account. The caller must have access to the selected subaccount.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc: Exact server-owned request ID returned by CreateInternalTransfer.

fields.name: transfer_id
fields.doc: Exact transfer ID returned by CreateInternalTransfer or ListTransfers.

types.name: transfer.v1.GetInternalTransferResponse
types.doc: GetInternalTransferResponse links an accepted transfer to its lifecycle flow.

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc: Stable server-owned intake request identifier.

fields.name: transfer_id
fields.doc: Stable transfer identifier shared by its debit and credit ledger entries.

fields.name: flow_id
fields.doc:
Authoritative lifecycle identifier for GetFlowById. The flow's ledger
 settlement step links back through milestone_tx_ref.

fields.name: accepted_at_ts_ns
fields.doc: Acceptance timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch (UTC).

types.name: transfer.v1.InternalTransferBatchLeg
types.doc:
InternalTransferBatchLeg is one transfer of a batch. It takes the fields of
 CreateInternalTransferRequest except the idempotency key, which the batch
 carries for all of its legs.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional source public subaccount ID. When omitted, subaccount-scoped API
 keys use their bound subaccount; other callers use their authenticated
 root account. Legs of one batch may debit different source accounts.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: destination_account_id
fields.doc: Destination root account public id.

fields.name: destination_subaccount_id
fields.doc: Destination subaccount public id.

fields.name: destination_smart_account_address
fields.doc: Destination smart-account address.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: Canonical public unified asset id for the asset being transferred.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc:
Transfer amount in canonical 18-decimal unified asset units.
 For example, 0.5 is encoded as 500000000000000000.

types.name: transfer.v1.InternalTransferBatchLegResult
types.doc: InternalTransferBatchLegResult is the outcome of one leg, in request order.

fields.name: leg_index
fields.doc: Zero-based position of the leg in the request.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Outcome of the leg.

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc:
Stable server-owned request identifier of the leg's transfer. Use it with
 GetInternalTransfer. Empty while the leg has not been submitted.

fields.name: transfer_id
fields.doc: Stable transfer identifier, set once the leg is accepted.

fields.name: flow_id
fields.doc: Authoritative lifecycle flow identifier, set once the leg is accepted.

fields.name: accepted_at_ts_ns
fields.doc:
Acceptance timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch (server time), set once
 the leg is accepted.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: Echoed canonical public unified asset id.

fields.name: asset_code
fields.doc: Resolved asset code, set once the leg is submitted.

fields.name: amount_e18
fields.doc: Echoed transfer amount in canonical 18-decimal unified asset units.

fields.name: destination
fields.doc: Server-resolved destination summary, set once the leg is submitted.

fields.name: error_code
fields.doc:
Why the leg was refused, or why its outcome is not known yet. Unset for an
 accepted leg and for a leg that was not submitted.

fields.name: error_message
fields.doc: Human-readable description of error_code.

types.name: transfer.v1.InternalTransferBatchLegStatus
types.doc: InternalTransferBatchLegStatus is the outcome of one leg of a batch.

values.name: LEG_ACCEPTED
values.doc: The leg's transfer was accepted and has a durable transfer identifier.

values.name: LEG_PENDING
values.doc:
The leg's outcome is not known yet. The transfer runs to its outcome
 without the caller: read it with GetInternalTransfer, or retry the batch
 with the same idempotency key.

values.name: LEG_REFUSED
values.doc:
The leg moved no funds; error_code gives the reason. A retry of the batch
 with the same idempotency key runs a submitted leg again.

values.name: LEG_NOT_SUBMITTED
values.doc:
The leg did not run: its batch was refused, or the request ended before
 the leg started. A retry with the same idempotency key runs it.

types.name: transfer.v1.InternalTransferBatchStatus
types.doc: InternalTransferBatchStatus is the outcome of a batch request as a whole.

values.name: BATCH_SUBMITTED
values.doc:
Every leg passed its checks and the batch was submitted. Legs run
 independently: read each leg's status.

values.name: BATCH_REFUSED
values.doc:
At least one leg failed its checks, so no leg ran, no funds moved and no
 step-up verification was used. Failed legs carry their reason; the other
 legs are LEG_NOT_SUBMITTED.

types.name: transfer.v1.InternalTransferStatus
types.doc:
InternalTransferStatus is the public user-facing status for an internal
 transfer request.

values.name: INTERNAL_TRANSFER_STATUS_ACCEPTED
values.doc: The transfer request was accepted and has a durable transfer identifier.

values.name: INTERNAL_TRANSFER_STATUS_REJECTED
values.doc: The transfer request was rejected before durable acceptance.

values.name: INTERNAL_TRANSFER_STATUS_FAILED
values.doc: The transfer request failed terminally before durable acceptance.

types.name: transfer.v1.ListDustBalancesRequest
types.doc:
ListDustBalancesRequest judges the account's Trading balances for
 conversion into one target.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional public subaccount ID. When omitted, subaccount-scoped API keys use
 their bound subaccount; other callers use their authenticated root account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: target_asset_id
fields.doc: Target asset id, one of the response's targets; 0 means the first target.

types.name: transfer.v1.ListDustBalancesResponse
types.doc:
ListDustBalancesResponse lists every nonzero available Trading balance with
 its eligibility and the payout the eligible ones would bring now. It
 reserves nothing; QuoteDustConversion prices a conversion.

fields.name: target_asset_id
fields.doc: Target asset id the balances were judged for.

fields.name: targets
fields.doc: Every asset id the account can convert dust into, in preference order.

fields.name: fee_bps
fields.doc: The fee in basis points, taken from the payout.

fields.name: balances
fields.doc: Every nonzero available Trading balance, in asset id order.

fields.name: gross_usd_e18
fields.doc:
The eligible balances' total USD value in 18-decimal fixed point, rounded
 down.

fields.name: payout_e18
fields.doc:
The payout they would bring now, in canonical 18-decimal target units,
 after the fee.

fields.name: target_available
fields.doc:
Whether the target can be paid now. When false, QuoteDustConversion is
 refused with ERROR_CODE_DUST_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE.

types.name: transfer.v1.ListDustConversionsRequest
types.doc: ListDustConversionsRequest lists the account's conversions, newest first.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional public subaccount ID. When omitted, subaccount-scoped API keys use
 their bound subaccount; other callers use their authenticated root account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum number of conversions to return: 0 means 20, at most 100.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque, exclusive, keyset-backed cursor from a previous response, bound to
 the caller's account or subaccount and the newest-first creation order.
 Empty for the first page.

types.name: transfer.v1.ListDustConversionsResponse
types.doc: ListDustConversionsResponse returns one page of conversions, newest first.

fields.name: conversions
fields.doc: Conversions ordered by creation time, newest first.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: transfer.v1.QuoteDustConversionRequest
types.doc: QuoteDustConversionRequest prices the account's dust into one target.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Optional public subaccount ID. When omitted, subaccount-scoped API keys use
 their bound subaccount; other callers use their authenticated root account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: target_asset_id
fields.doc: Target asset id, one of ListDustBalances' targets.

types.name: transfer.v1.QuoteDustConversionResponse
types.doc: QuoteDustConversionResponse is a quote valid for 30 seconds.

fields.name: quote_id
fields.doc:
Quote identifier CreateDustConversion takes. Empty when no balance is
 eligible or their payout rounds to zero; balances still says why.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc:
After this time CreateDustConversion refuses the quote with
 ERROR_CODE_DUST_QUOTE_EXPIRED.

fields.name: target_asset_id
fields.doc: Target asset id.

fields.name: fee_bps
fields.doc: The fee in basis points, taken from the payout.

fields.name: gross_usd_e18
fields.doc: The sources' total USD value in 18-decimal fixed point, rounded down.

fields.name: payout_e18
fields.doc:
Payout in canonical 18-decimal target units, after the fee, rounded down
 to the target's quantity precision.

fields.name: balances
fields.doc:
Every nonzero available Trading balance, sources and others, in asset id
 order.

fields.name: prices
fields.doc: Prices of the sources and the target, in asset id order.

types.name: transfer.v1.ResolvedDestination
types.doc:
ResolvedDestination describes the normalized transfer destination selected by
 the server after public-id / smart-account resolution.

fields.name: root_account_public_id
fields.doc: Destination root account public id.

fields.name: subaccount_public_id
fields.doc: Destination subaccount public id when the destination targets a subaccount.

fields.name: smart_account_address
fields.doc: Destination smart-account address resolved by the server.
